summary: Red Robin Gourmet Burgers filed an 8-K reporting that on October 2, 2026 it terminated its prior March 4, 2022 credit agreement and entered a new five-year $115 million Credit Agreement with JPMorgan Chase as administrative and collateral agent, Texas Capital Bank as documentation agent, and JPMorgan and U.S. Bank as joint lead arrangers. The facility comprises a $25 million revolver and $90 million term loan, matures October 2, 2031, carries 5.0%/7.5%/10.0% annual amortization steps, and permits up to $20 million of additional capacity. This is an ordinary refinancing, not a special situation.
